capabilities: receive webhooks from Zapier, Make, n8n, AI agents, or any HTTP client
create vault notes from JSON payloads with YAML frontmatter
deliver events in real time via SSE with polling fallback
guarantee exactly-once delivery through an ACK system
encrypt event data at rest with AES-256-GCM
extras: Self-hosting a server is required: deployment uses Docker, Nginx, PostgreSQL (Supabase), and Mailgun for magic-link email. The listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian cannot receive events from external services (automation platforms, AI agents, custom APIs) and turn them into notes on its own.

relations.evidence: Inspired by obsidian-webhooks by @trashhalo — the original proof of concept

requires.name: email account for passwordless magic-link registration
webhook senders such as Zapier, Make, n8n, or a custom HTTP client
self-hosted dependencies (Docker, PostgreSQL/Supabase, Mailgun) to run the server

summary: Self-hosted webhook server with an Obsidian companion plugin that turns incoming HTTP events from external services into vault notes in real time.
